scope: KAOPU Tree Life Grammar R04 single-Mother trial only
problem: A tree can appear to gain branches with age only because one adult grammar is globally scaled across minimum-length/radius thresholds, while a separately named root function can still be a downward recursive branch substitute with no soil-specific response.
falsifiableHypothesis: For a declared developmental-stage crossing, requiring organ lineage/state events plus orthogonal light and soil-field interventions will reject Tree R03 and synthetic scale/mirror substitutes while preserving a candidate with explicit developmental history, root-specific soil response, shoot-specific light response, and collar continuity.
gate: Only apply the developmental assertion when the tested time pair crosses a source-backed stage boundary; nearby times inside one stage are NOT_APPLICABLE rather than automatic failures.
A change in branch count is not developmental proof unless new organs/states bind to stable lineage IDs and birth, activation, dormancy, break or wound events.
If age enters only through global length/radius scale, reject even when minimum-size thresholds accidentally change output topology.

Reverse a non-uniform light field and a non-uniform soil-moisture field separately. Shoot allocation must show a light-specific response and root allocation a soil-specific response, within source-backed tolerances.
Root and shoot response signatures may be coupled but may not be identical, sign-reflected copies driven by one generic recursion without declared causal channels.
Seed-root-collar-trunk truth-layer continuity must pass the declared position/tangent tolerances.
Passing this gate verifies causal separation only; it does not approve species identity, 3A appearance, browser delivery or user acceptance.

activation.rollbackPoint: Delete or ignore this Candidate; keep Tree R03 rejected and do not alter main, gh-pages or any production branch.
